Native Windows source reconstruction for the reveal-presence announcement.
This is an extraction of the configured PE files, with no game interaction.

Images and function ranges are recorded in native-owners.tsv and field-native-owners.tsv.
Steam producer: 0x1402afed0..0x1402b18c8, executable instructions end at RET 0x1402b17b7.
Classic producer: 0x1402ada90..0x1402af488, executable instructions end at RET 0x1402af377.
The remaining function bytes are two native 34-entry tables used for knowledge-record
updates. They do not select announcement prose. All original bytes are represented by
the full unwind-range assembly, while native-branches.tsv retains the instruction edges.

Announcement production (Steam addresses):
  REQUIRE recipient has soul at unit+0xa98                     0x1402aff10
  for each unread knowledge objective type 10                 0x1402b0dd6..0x1402b0de3:
    require native soul trait/knowledge sharing predicate      0x1402b0de9..0x1402b0e09
    require context object type 17 and a found artifact        0x1402b0e1a..0x1402b0e9b
    resolve artifact presence coordinates:
      unlocated -> rumor/unknown-presence record, no report   0x1402b0eb3..0x1402b0ed3
      item direct position -> xyz from item+8/+a/+c           0x1402b0fa8
      item in a container/holder -> native reference slots   0x1402b0ed9..0x1402b0fa6
    require resolved X coordinate != -30000                  0x1402b0fcb
    build one knowledge record selected from:
      type 25 = artifact has holder/site id at artifact+a8    0x1402b0fd7
      type 26 = artifact+b4 present                          0x1402b0ffc
      type 27 = artifact+b8 present                          0x1402b1011
      type 28 = artifact+bc present                          0x1402b1026
      type 29 = unresolved/unknown position, no report        0x1402b1252
    record knowledge before formatting                       0x1402b106f
    report enabled if native mode/announcement flags allow   0x1402b1074..0x1402b1092
    text = full_actor_reference(speaker)                      0x1402b10e6 -> 0x141331500
    text += " has revealed the presence of "                 0x1402b111b
    text += artifact_reference(artifact.id, flags=0)          0x1402b113b -> 0x140b94400
    text += " to "                                           0x1402b1146
    text += full_actor_reference(recipient)                   0x1402b1163 -> 0x141331500
    text += "."                                              0x1402b1198
    capitalize(text)                                         0x1402b11b2 -> 0x14052d650
    submit(type=321 (0x141), color=6, duration=2000)          0x1402b122e -> 0x1400e3c20

There is exactly one prose production in this constructor, with two fully typed actor
fields and an artifact-title/item field. The four known-coordinate record selectors
and the unknown-location path affect knowledge, not the visible wording. The two
"error: intrigue actors identical" strings in the producer are error-log calls to
0x14052be80; they are not announcement branches.

Artifact field production (Steam 0x140b94400..0x140b94710;
Classic 0x140b91440..0x140b91750):
  record = lookup artifact id in native artifact vector
  if missing: append "an unknown artifact"                   0x140b946d8..0x140b946e8
  otherwise:
    if flags & 2:
      prepend LPAGE:BOOK or LPAGE:ARTIFACT markup
    title = language_name_english(record+8, true, false)      0x140b94530 -> 0x140a946e0
    if title empty:
      if item.virtual_getType()==0x59 or
         item.virtual_isWriting(0x14)==true or
         item.virtual_getType()==0x57:
        title = "Untitled"                                  0x140b945b0 / 0x140b9460b
      else:
        title = item_description(item,false,true)            0x140b94583 -> 0x140c65450
    append title
    if flags & 2: append [/LPAGE]

The announcement caller sets flags to 0, so link markup cannot appear in its title.
The missing-record fallback is retained as a full helper branch even though the normal
producer has already resolved the same artifact record. Generated artifact title
components are language-name WORD data; an empty ordinary title falls through to the
complete existing item-description grammar, including native materials, quality and
virtual object names. The item helper has two adjacent pdata pieces: full saved body
0x140c65450..0x140c65f0a is already available in ../fortress-announcement-artifacts/
steam-item-description.asm and the classic counterpart. The English title supplier
is already retained in ../adventure-travel-status/reference-english-generated-name.asm
(RVA 0xa946e0..0xa94ea2) and classic-english-generated-name.asm (0xa91760..0xa91f22).
No partial caption string is assumed to be the entire title.

Actor field production (Steam 0x141331500..0x141333724;
Classic 0x14132c470..0x14132e694):
  mode 4 or 5:
    return explicit animation name if nonempty, otherwise literal first_name
    first_name may be empty: the copy at 0x1413334cf..0x1413334db uses
    its real byte length, including zero, and returns normally. The classic
    branch is 0x14132e43a..0x14132e44b. Producer 321 has no caption-size
    guard and still appends its fixed middle, artifact, " to " and period.
    Native completed-report capitalization changes leading " has" to
    " Has" before visible whitespace normalization. In addition to the
    ordinary two-caption sentence, these three complete records exist:
      Has revealed the presence of {b} to {n}.
      {n} has revealed the presence of {b} to .
      Has revealed the presence of {b} to .
  selected_name = unit.name or native linked/disguised identity's chosen name
  selected_profession = unit.profession, optionally overridden by linked identity+ac
  supernatural definition:
    if deity flag: return "the deity" plus selected name only when disclosed
    else if force flag: return "the force" plus selected name only when disclosed
  if explicit animation name nonempty:
    text = "the " + authored animation label
    goto native name disclosure
  ordinary role:
    if unit.custom_profession nonempty:
      role = exact authored custom_profession; bypass RAW/enum/office/status replacement
    else if native RAW profession is available:
      role = capitalized caste profession, else race profession
      mark species already included
    else:
      switch selected_profession in 0..134:
        see actor-profession-dispatch.tsv for all 135 native destinations in both images
        102/outside range: "Peasant" only for viewpoint race, otherwise empty role
        103: RAW CHILD/BABY caste/race name if available, else "Child"
        104: RAW CHILD/BABY caste/race name if available, else "Baby"
      if an office exists: replace role with sex/plural-specific title, falling back
        to generic title; optionally remember an entity qualifier " of <entity>"
      if slave relationship exists: replace adult role with "Slave";
        child/baby with existing role append " Slave"
      if prisoner relationship exists: replace adult role with "Prisoner";
        child/baby with existing role append " Prisoner"; overrides slave choice
  text = "the " except profession104 without custom_profession, which omits article
  append optional preceding-description temporary when nonempty (rbp-0x41;
    initialized empty on the ordinary path, no additional fixed prose literal)
  if ghost and not named curse:
    append "Ghost" for empty same-race role; otherwise "Ghostly "
  if named curse with prefix but no curse name:
    append exact curse_prefix plus space
    if same viewpoint race: append "One"
  if foreign race and species not already included:
    append capitalized caste singular, falling back to race singular
  if curse has explicit name:
    append curse_name
  append role
  native name disclosure:
    if selected language_name has_name:
      fortress/non-adventure modes append name
      adventure mode appends only when native historical-figure/entity knowledge
      permits, possibly using actual unit.name instead of the linked identity
  append remembered office entity qualifier

No finite list can enumerate every generated actor or title spelling; the native
fields above define all relevant dynamic sources. The existing complete actor body
is referenced by field-native-owners.tsv rather than copied. Actual current-image
literal operands, calls and every condition/jump are retained in field-native-*.
All 135 profession table entries were read directly from the current PE's native
jump table; they include Poet=113 and Crossbowman=79 from the screenshot.

Current implementation owns this actor formatter at src/native_unit_identity_hooks.inc:
entry[5] hooks 0x1331500 with capture_native_unit_reference. It records chosen Literal,
Name, Species, Role, Curse, Title and Authored appends, then renders them in
src/native_unit_identity_translation.inc. Authored animation/custom profession and
language-less first_name without WORDs remain literal. Native language WORD character
names are phonetic, nicknames default to authored text, and office entities use their
separate entity-name grammar. Name visibility follows native choices.

The report stores an already formatted sentence. Re-rendering the popup does not
necessarily re-call the actor supplier. Unit-source associations are temporary and
are cleared with the native capture epoch; additionally capitalization changes the
first actor's native "the" to "The" inside the completed report. Announcement grammar
therefore needs its own complete field grammar or semantic record association rather
than depending solely on a current-frame source-string association. This observation
comes from the report constructor and the source registry code, not from running a game.

Completed-report capitalization supplier
=======================================
Reference 0x14052d650..0x14052d904, classic 0x14052b070..0x14052b324.
Each owner has three adjacent pdata segments: entry, loop and epilogue/tables.
Executable bytes end after RET at 0x14052d8b9 / 0x14052b2d9. The following
9-entry RVA table and 36-byte selector table are data, not instructions.
Both actual current PE bodies and all conditional branches are retained in
reference-report-capitalization.asm / classic-report-capitalization.asm and
field-native-branches.tsv. All 36 CP437 selectors, including default branches,
are retained in report-capitalization-switch.tsv. This supplier makes no calls
and contains no prose strings.

capitalize_report(string):
  if size == 0: return                                  0x14052d667
  bracket_depth = 0; initial = true
  for index in [0, size):                               0x14052d690
    if byte[index] == '[': ++bracket_depth; continue    0x14052d69f
    if byte[index] == ']': --bracket_depth; continue    0x14052d6bc
    if bracket_depth > 0: continue                     0x14052d6ca
    if not initial:
      eligible = preceding byte is space or double quote
      if preceding byte is apostrophe:
        eligible also when index <= 0, or index >= 2 and
        byte[index-2] is space or comma                0x14052d711..0x14052d74a
      if not eligible: continue                       0x14052d74c
    if 'a' <= signed_byte[index] <= 'z':
      byte[index] -= 0x20; return                      0x14052d761..0x14052d811
    select signed_byte[index] + 0x7f, bounded to 0..35:
      0x81 (ue) -> 0x9a (UE)                          0x14052d816
      0x82 (e acute) -> 0x90 (E acute)                 0x14052d85e
      0x84 (a diaeresis) -> 0x8e (A diaeresis)         0x14052d83a
      0x86 (a ring) -> 0x8f (A ring)                   0x14052d84c
      0x87 (c cedilla) -> 0x80 (C cedilla)             0x14052d882
      0x91 (ae) -> 0x92 (AE)                          0x14052d894
      0x94 (o diaeresis) -> 0x99 (O diaeresis)         0x14052d870
      0xa4 (n tilde) -> 0xa5 (N tilde)                 0x14052d828
      each replacement returns immediately
      other selectors enter the native default below 0x14052d7ac
    if byte[index] is space or double quote:
      initial = false; continue
    return unchanged                                  0x14052d8a4

This is a byte/CP437 routine with markup-depth and quote/space branches, not
a Unicode uppercase operation and not an ASCII-first-byte-only operation.
The announcement identity matcher now invokes the already resolved native
assign and capitalize suppliers on an owned disposable NativeSearchString;
it therefore follows the running host's actual rules without changing any
game-owned field. Its ASCII fallback is used only before supplier pointers
are available.

Unnamed item fallback and report field staging
=============================================
b94400(mode=0) uses c65450(item,false,true) at 0x140b94583 when the
artifact title is empty and the item is neither a book, writing nor slab.
c65450's object path invokes +5f0 at 0x140c65769 and +5e8 at 0x140c65a34,
0x140c65a89, 0x140c65ae4, 0x140c65b39, 0x140c65b94 or 0x140c65bc1.
The actual body-component/corpse/corpsepiece vtables resolve +5f0 to
0x140ca0d60 (classic 0x140c9dda0) and +5e8 to 0x140ca1aa0
(classic 0x140c9eae0). Ordinary item article +5f0 is 0x140c653e0;
ordinary description +5e8 is 0x140ca5bb0 and calls material/body noun
supplier 0x140a82c10. Constructed container descriptions can recursively
call c65450 for their contents; they retain the same item virtual suppliers.

The full corpse/body supplier is retained in reference/classic-item-body-
description.asm with all calls, conditional branches and literal operands.
Its unit/history possessive names use a94030 at 0x140ca1bfc and
0x140ca1cb7 (classic a910b0 at c9ec3c/c9ecf7). The unnamed current-unit
branch calls the independent movement reference 132e430 at 0x140ca1da2
(classic 13293a0 at 0x140c9ede2); the species branch calls 132e0c0 at
0x140ca1dd2 (classic 1329030 at 0x140c9ee12). The movement formatter
does not call 1331500: its complete body is already retained in
../adventure-target-panel/helper-reference-identity.asm and the classic
counterpart. These suppliers therefore do not add another native 1331500
caption between producer 321's two calls.

The movement entry and 1331500 share the C++ semantic finisher. Staging
every published result of that finisher would still let the body's movement
caption displace the speaker even though the native full-reference entry
was not called. NativeUnitIdentityCall.announcement_reference now records
that the actual entry[5] is active; only that entry stages completed reports.
Movement/name helpers keep their existing identity publication without
adding report candidates. Empty 1331500 returns stage a structure marker
without a name snapshot. Exact full-report prefix and suffix proof still
consumes both native results, and stores identities only for visible
nonempty captions. Old report recovery permits the native empty return and
uses the complete assembled prefix's native capitalization, preserving the
same complete-caption anchoring for all four visible sentence forms.
